high_level_description: The image depicts a group of women standing on the steps of a stone building with a traditional architectural style. The building has a stone facade and features a large window with green shutters on the left side and a set of double doors with green frames on the right side. The women are dressed in a variety of colorful outfits, ranging from formal to casual, suggesting a diverse and inclusive gathering. The women appear to be posing for a group photo, as they are standing close together and facing the camera.
